description: Source code for UE Location Manager handling location reporting configuration, UE presence checks, and report generation in a 3GPP-compliant network component.

classes.name: ue_location_manager
classes.description: Manages UE location reporting configuration, generates location reports, and checks UE presence within areas of interest.

methods.name: configure_location_reporting
methods.description: Configures location reporting based on incoming request, handling different event types and updating internal configuration.

methods.name: get_current_location_reporting_type
methods.description: Returns the current location reporting event type based on configuration.

methods.name: check_ue_presence
methods.description: Checks if a UE is within a specified area of interest based on cell, TAI, or RAN node lists.

methods.name: get_location_report
methods.description: Generates a location report for a UE if reporting conditions are met.

methods.name: get_direct_location_report
methods.description: Creates a direct location report based on provided user location info and request.

methods.name: build_ue_presence_list
methods.description: Builds a list of UE presence items for areas of interest based on current configuration and user location.
